enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Adjust pillow. Lie on back. Move arm. Remain still. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up to start the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off tap. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed breakfast using the toaster and kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Open fridge. Take out milk and butter. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out plate and cup. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Wait for toast. Remove toast from toaster. Butter toast. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Stir. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing business course lecture notes on the computer at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open lecture notes file. Scroll through notes. Read notes. Highlight key points. Take notes on paper. Type notes on computer. Save file. Close file. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the couch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put feet on coffee table. Pick up phone. Scroll through phone. Put phone down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on a marketing assignment on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open computer. Open marketing assignment file. Type text. Click mouse. Scroll page. Read assignment brief. Reference notes. Type more. Save file. Close file. Turn off computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping for the week at the local supermarket
enriched_activities.desc: Leave house. Walk to supermarket. Enter supermarket. Pick up basket. Walk through aisles. Select groceries. Place in basket. Go to checkout. Pay. Receive receipt. Carry bags home. Enter house. Put groceries on kitchen counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch using the induction cooker and microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Unpack groceries. Take out ingredients. Place on counter. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir with spatula. Turn on microwave. Place food in microwave. Set timer. Remove food. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing assignment work and reading on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Continue typing assignment. Read notes. Scroll through document. Take a break. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Type more. Read article. Highlight text. Save file. Close computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing video games and watching TV for leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up controller. Turn on game console. Select game. Play game. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pause game. Pick up phone. Scroll through phone. Put phone down. Resume game. Turn off console. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing a load of laundry with the washing machine and folding clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Gather dirty clothes. Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Load clothes. Add detergent. Close door. Set cycle. Start machine. Wait. Remove clothes. Hang clothes. Fold clothes. Put clothes away. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Going for a walk and light exercise around the neighbourhood
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Leave house. Walk around neighbourhood. Jog. Stop. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Walk back home. Enter house. Take off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the oven and induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Prepare ingredients. Preheat oven. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Place food in oven. Set timer. Remove food from oven. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Streaming a show on TV and relaxing
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Open streaming app. Select show. Watch show. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Scroll through phone. Put phone down. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Planning the upcoming study and retail work week on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open calendar. Plan study schedule. Type in deadlines. Plan work shifts. Type in shifts. Save calendar. Close calendar. Turn off computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and brushing teeth before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Scrolling on the phone and winding down in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Read posts. Like post. Scroll more. Open messaging app. Read messages. Reply to message. Put phone down. Adjust pillow. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Adjust pillow. Lie on back. Move arm. Remain still. Continue sleeping.
